defs.def: the structure that covers or forms the top of a building or vehicle 顶部；屋顶；车顶

ex.s: The original iron boxes with the round roofs first appeared in 1926.
ex.t: 带有圆形屋顶的原始铁皮电话亭于1926年首次出现。

ex.s: He asked the workers to use traditional techniques to make the bricks into walls, roofs and corridors.
ex.t: 成年人都明白被物品包围是什么感觉。

ex.s: A regular character in the letters was Polar Bear,who once climbed the North Pole (an actual pole in this case) and fell through the roof of Father Christmas’s house.
ex.t: 字母中的一个普通人物是北极熊，他曾经爬过北极（在这种情况下是实际的极点） ，从圣诞老人家的屋顶上掉了下来。

ex.s: I was sitting in my room with my cat, Smarrie, on my lap, when the roof just flew off.
ex.t: 我当时正坐在房间里，我的猫斯玛莉趴在我腿上，这时屋顶突然飞掉了。

ex.s: All of a sudden, there was sky where the roof had been.
ex.t: 突然间，原来屋顶的地方变成了天空。

ex.s: Without a roof, staying inside was too dangerous.
ex.t: 没有屋顶，待在里面太危险了。

ex.s: It is made with local materials, has a flat roof, wood paneling, concrete floors and custom-made furniture.
ex.t: 它使用当地材料建造，有平屋顶、木镶板、混凝土地面和定制家具。

defs.def: having the type of roof mentioned 构成形容词

ex.s: Four years ago they all moved into a three-storey Victorian house in Bristol — one of a growing number of multigenerational families in the UK living together under the same roof.
ex.t: 四年前，他们全都搬进了布里斯托尔一栋三层维多利亚式住宅——这是英国越来越多几代人同堂、住在同一屋檐下的家庭之一。

defs.def: the top of an underground space such as a tunnel or cave 洞顶；隧道顶

ex.s: The words “railways like massive dragons are winding among the mountains” seem particularly vivid as I travel across the “roof of the world”.
ex.t: 当我穿越“世界屋脊”时， “铁路像巨龙一样在山间蜿蜒”这句话似乎特别生动。

defs.def: the top of the inside of your mouth 口腔顶部；腭部
to rise or increase very quickly 价格等
to become very angry 非常生气；暴怒
